title: Adonia's Trifusion Stormweaver Build Guide

changes: Fourth-batch source-reviewed publication. Cross-verified from official 0.5 patch notes, current creator guides, an independent build guide, a planner, a current gameplay video and community questions.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: 'Trifusion' refers to the build running three elements (lightning, cold, fire) through a Stormweaver that leverages Adonia's Ego, Elemental Storm and Pinnacle of Power. It is not a cheap league starter: the rotation and the Spirit gate are the real cost.
This is verification-first. The exact supports and Spirit math come from the current creator guide; the variant boundaries and the Spirit budget are the actionable part.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Strong multi-element coverage and high ceiling.
Pinnacle of Power adds a large burst window when timed.
Adonia's Ego enables the granted-skill playstyle.
cons: High Spirit gate - not a cheap league starter.
Piano playstyle: multiple skills to press on a rotation.
Video config and current planner can differ; verify before copying.
Luxury uniques are exactly that - not starter requirements.

sections.title: Is This Build Right For You?
paragraphs: Pick Adonia Trifusion if you enjoy a piano caster with a high ceiling and you can meet the Spirit gate. It is not for players who want a one-button league starter.
Confirm your Spirit total (base + gear + reservation efficiency) before committing. Without the gate, the rotation does not function.

steps.label: Campaign - Generic Sorceress
body: Level with Spark or a basic spell. The Trifusion tools come online after the Stormweaver ascendancy and Adonia's Ego.

steps.label: Early Maps - Spirit gate
body: Accumulate Spirit from gear and tree. Reach the minimum total before attempting the full rotation.

steps.label: Endgame - Rotation
body: Run the full elemental rotation with Pinnacle of Power timed. Benchmark on T15 before luxury upgrades.

sections.title: Trifusion Engine
paragraphs: The build grants a skill via Adonia's Ego and ties it into Elemental Storm (triggered by crits) and Pinnacle of Power (a timed buff). The 'three' elements are maintained so each part of the engine has something to amplify.
Adonia's Ego charge roll is a minor modifier, not a make-or-break stat. Do not over-pay for a specific roll.

sections.title: Spirit Budget
sections.caption: Minimum Spirit accounting before the rotation works.

sections.title: Pinnacle of Power Timeline
paragraphs: Generate charges -> activate Pinnacle of Power -> place Sigil/Frost Bomb -> establish main output -> CoC/CoEA auto-triggers -> mana check -> prepare next round before the buff ends.

sections.title: Variant Boundary
sections.caption: Realistic boundaries instead of treating the creator's Giga as the default.

skills.role: Granted skill from the unique; core of the engine
whyUse: Drives the trifusion engine together with Elemental Storm.

skills.displayName: Cast on Crit / Cast on Elemental Ailment
notes: Required trigger support; confirm against current planner.

recommendations: The signature unique that grants a skill. Not strictly mandatory for a basic caster, but central to this build's identity.
Rings, amulet and body armour that provide Spirit. This is the real entry cost.
High-end items that push the ceiling. Not starter requirements.

steps.label: Reach Spirit gate
body: Gear and tree Spirit first; without it nothing else matters.

steps.label: Stabilize mana
body: Add regen/leech so Comet chains do not empty mana.

steps.label: Push damage
body: Only after the gate and mana are stable, add luxury uniques.

sections.title: Budget Variants
paragraphs: Starter runs a reduced rotation that still meets the Spirit minimum. Mid adds more persistent skills. Late completes the core uniques. Giga is a showcase, not a budget target.

sections.title: Defensive Layers
paragraphs: Energy Shield plus mana-layer recovery is the base. The piano rotation leaves little room for mistakes, so keep resistances capped and a defensive aura up.

sections.title: Mapping Rotation
paragraphs: For mapping: keep the rotation simple - maintain the granted skill and Elemental Storm, drop Sigil, and move. Do not over-press on trash.

sections.title: Rare Rotation
paragraphs: For rares: add the timed buff and the Sundering support. Keep mana in check; a dead rare is better than an empty-mana death.

sections.title: Boss Rotation
paragraphs: For bosses: pre-cast the setup, activate Pinnacle of Power on the burst window, then disengage before the buff ends to restart the loop. Verify the order against the current planner.

sections.title: Community Voices

entries.statement: Players repeatedly ask how much Spirit is needed; the answer is build-specific and must be read from the current planner, not guessed.

entries.label: Forum - Comet mana
entries.statement: Several report that continuous Comet triggers drain mana; the fix is regen/leech, not more damage.

sections.note: Short paraphrases of common community questions and concerns, edited for clarity. Not verbatim quotes.

items.question: Why is it called Trifusion?
answer: Because it maintains three elements (lightning, cold, fire) so the Stormweaver engine has something to amplify across the rotation.

items.question: Is Adonia's Ego absolutely required?
answer: It is the signature unique that defines the playstyle, but a basic caster can function without it. For this specific Trifusion identity, it is central.

items.question: Why does the video config differ from the planner?
answer: Creators update the planner after recording. Always read the current planner for the live version; treat the video as a demonstration, not the final loadout.

items.question: What if I cannot meet the Spirit gate?
answer: Use a reduced rotation that still meets the minimum, or build a different Stormweaver variant. Do not force the full piano rotation without the gate.

checks: Check Spirit total and reservation efficiency. Below the gate, the rotation collapses.
Add mana regen/leech and reduce trigger frequency temporarily. Mana is the limiter, not damage.
